response.sql: WITH station_avgs AS (SELECT observstation, AVG(bandusagepct) AS mean_usage FROM telescopes WHERE bandusagepct IS NOT NULL GROUP BY observstation), overall_avg AS (SELECT AVG(bandusagepct) AS avg_usage FROM telescopes WHERE bandusagepct IS NOT NULL) SELECT AVG(s.mean_usage) AS mean_bandwidth_usage, AVG(s.mean_usage - o.avg_usage) AS average_above_overall FROM station_avgs AS s CROSS JOIN overall_avg AS o WHERE s.mean_usage > o.avg_usage;
